notes:
PlaneSite 1.6.14:
- Another fix for the window freezing while an orthomosaic renders. Processing itself was finishing normally each time; the window stopped updating at about the moment the graphics card starts its rendering work. The PlaneSite window now draws without the graphics card, so a busy NVIDIA card can't hold it up. This takes effect the next time PlaneSite is opened after the update (close the PlaneSite window and start it again).
- If the window still runs into a problem, PlaneSite now records exactly where (with readable details) in its log, which Save diagnostics includes.
